release_notes: Fixed vendor/bin/composer path error and improved autoload methods
changelog: Critical Fix: Removed incorrect vendor/bin/composer path that was causing 'Could not open input file' error
Fix: Now uses shell_exec with cd /d command for proper directory context on Windows
Enhancement: Tries direct composer command first (simplest and most reliable)
Enhancement: Falls back to composer.phar if it exists in project root
Enhancement: Uses Artisan::call for optimize:clear (more reliable than shell commands)
Enhancement: Added manual artisan optimize as final fallback
Improvement: Better success detection by checking for 'Generated optimized autoload' in output
